dialect.detail: IBM mainframe DB2 COBOL program, edited in ISPF editor (ADS02.ADS0205.SRC dataset). Uses EXEC SQL with DB2 cursor, SQLCA, DCLGEN-generated host variable structures (DCLTARTICL, TLIGCOM). French-language comments suggest French IBM mainframe shop.
evidence: EXEC SQL DECLARE CURS1 CURSOR FOR

purpose.domain_detail: Inventory/stock management: identifies articles present in stock but never sold (not in order lines table TLIGCOM), to mark them for clearance sale.
purpose.summary: Program ADSD225 opens a DB2 cursor (CURS1) that selects articles from TARTICL that have no matching rows in TLIGCOM (order lines), i.e. articles never sold. It fetches each row and displays a formatted table of article code, label, price, and quantity. Handles SQL errors and warnings separately.

notable_features: EXEC SQL cursor (DECLARE, OPEN, FETCH, CLOSE)
EXEC SQL INCLUDE TARTICL / TLIGCOM (DCLGEN copybooks)
GOBACK instead of STOP RUN for main termination
Correlated subquery NOT EXISTS in cursor SELECT
ISPF editor metadata visible in source (screen capture artifact)
